summary: Install FBRX Command on a computer of your own with one double-click, and join it from the computers on your home or school network, no domain name needed.
notes: New next to the FBRX OS installers: "Install FBRX Command" (Windows and Mac). It installs FBRX Command, starts it whenever you log in, adds an FBRX Command icon, and opens the first-run page with its setup token filled in.

Home and school networks: FBRX Command serves HTTPS with its own certificate. Computers check its fingerprint once when they join (FBRX shows it; Deploy & enroll shows the same) and then trust nothing else.
FBRX Command signs licenses with the same key as "Install FBRX OS", so its licenses work on your computers.
Provisioning files, Mac profiles, Windows scripts and license keys from FBRX Command carry the certificate fingerprint, so computers join on their own.
Run the installer again to update FBRX Command, or with --uninstall to remove it; its data is kept.
